items.title: Realty Income (O) On Loan Changes And The Case For A Discount
items.summary: Why Realty Income’s latest term loan amendments matter now Realty Income (O) has updated two major term loan agreements, covering a US$500 million facility and up to US$1.35b of multi currency borrowings, in order to align them with its recently revised credit agreement. Against that backdrop, Realty Income’s share price has eased 1.2% over the past week and 2.0% over the past month. It is still up 6.9% year to date, while the 1 year total shareholder return of 8.9% points to more supportive...
